## Change

What changed and why? Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run format:check` and `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build`
- [ ] Browser/GPU checks appropriate to any behaviour change (or explain why not)
- [ ] Model, data and scientific-claim changes are documented explicitly

Include the reproduction/check result, not just a checked box.
